units.rawText: I don't know how to define my present self. I have Eos' name and her appearance, but I'm not really her.
units.displayText: I don't know how to define my present self. I have Eos' name and her appearance, but I'm not really her.

spans.text: I don't know how to define my present self. I have Eos' name and her appearance, but I'm not really her.

units.rawText: After all, all the data that comprises me now was born from a fragment of Eosphorus... it's as though I were a ghost.
units.displayText: After all, all the data that comprises me now was born from a fragment of Eosphorus... it's as though I were a ghost.

spans.text: After all, all the data that comprises me now was born from a fragment of Eosphorus... it's as though I were a ghost.

units.rawText: ...Oh my, Professor. I thought you'd say something to console me, but you decided to give me a hug instead?
units.displayText: ...Oh my, Professor. I thought you'd say something to console me, but you decided to give me a hug instead?

spans.text: ...Oh my, Professor. I thought you'd say something to console me, but you decided to give me a hug instead?

units.rawText: That's sneaky, Professor. I wonder if you could consider it slacking on the job? Or are you saying that you want to form a bond with my current self?
units.displayText: That's sneaky, Professor. I wonder if you could consider it slacking on the job? Or are you saying that you want to form a bond with my current self?

spans.text: That's sneaky, Professor. I wonder if you could consider it slacking on the job? Or are you saying that you want to form a bond with my current self?

units.rawText: It's so warm... Does this softness belong exclusively to the present me? Is it mine, and mine alone...
units.displayText: It's so warm... Does this softness belong exclusively to the present me? Is it mine, and mine alone...
